0022600161.text: The Knicks (2-4, 1-2 at home) host the Brooklyn Nets (0-5, 0-3 at home) in New York's seventh game of the season, with New York 4th in the Atlantic and 3.5 games back and 11th in the East, while Brooklyn sits 5th in the Atlantic, five games back, and 15th in the East. Brooklyn enters on a five-game losing streak, while New York has dropped its last game; Jose Alvarado is out for the Knicks with an ankle sprain, and Egor Demin (leg bruise), Mikel Brown Jr. (rest), and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain) are out for the Nets. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but the Knicks won all four matchups in 2025-26, most recently a 93-92 win in Brooklyn on March 20, 2026.
